information_loss_summary.headline: Removing WHO numeric values would not change production runtime behavior (HOW/CRTConfig path), but would change governance census continuity, cross-authority comparison, dependency census population, and WHO-side human reference numbers. Required-reference role remains unproven.

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: Absence of production-runtime consumption of a WHO numeric value does not authorize removal or cleanup eligibility.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: OCC-09 NO_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_VALUE_CONSUMER + OCC-04/05/07 value consumers show non-runtime information surfaces still exist
eligibility_ruleset.counterexample_prevented: treating IC-008 HOW-only runtime proof as deletion license

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: Presence of an equivalent HOW path or equal CRTConfig seed value does not prove the WHO value is redundant or safe to remove.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: Phase-4 semantic_identity_proven remains NO under name/value non-equivalence rules; IC-008 disposition PRESERVE_NO_ACTION for six drifts
eligibility_ruleset.information_loss_risk_addressed: loss of independent WHO-side comparison term

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: Key-only consumers authorize key retention analysis only; they do not prove numeric value removal safety.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: THRESHOLD_KEY_SET_TEST consumes keys and explicitly refuses value pins
eligibility_ruleset.information_loss_risk_addressed: confusing key inventory with value authority

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: If any governance scanner, dependency census, or drift artifact consumes the numeric value, SAFE_TO_REMOVE_VALUE is forbidden until those surfaces are explicitly re-specified without the value (out of scope here).
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: OCC-04 GOVERNANCE_SURPLUS_CENSUS and OCC-05 DEPENDENCY_CENSUS_SELF read values
eligibility_ruleset.counterexample_prevented: stripping values while frozen census tests still expect them

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: If unknown_loss_risk is YES or any required information surface is unproven, classification must be UNPROVEN with disposition PRESERVE_NO_ACTION.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: Phase-5 marks unknown_loss_risk=YES for residual future readers and unproven 'reference' role of WHO numbers
eligibility_ruleset.counterexample_prevented: converting incomplete evidence into cleanup permission

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: KEEP_AS_NONAUTHORITATIVE_REFERENCE requires proof that the WHO value is a required non-runtime information function — mere usefulness or descriptive appearance is insufficient.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: Docs/scanners cite values, but no repository contract declares WHO numeric defaults as a required reference surface (tests disclaim value authority)

eligibility_ruleset.rule_statement: MIGRATION_REQUIRED requires an identified existing destination authority and a proven need to move the information surface; this census does not invent destinations or a fourth YAML.
eligibility_ruleset.evidence_that_required_rule: HOW/CRTConfig already hold runtime numbers; no proven requirement to migrate WHO descriptive numbers into them
eligibility_ruleset.counterexample_prevented: creating fourth YAML or forced migration theater
